title: Board Play Pointer Still Blocked
description: Board play still has no canvas interaction after bubble-phase ContextMenuController fix. Find remaining blockers (capture listeners, overlays, eventSurface wiring).
summary: Board stayed dead inside sketchpad because OriginDocumentListener registered document pointerdown in capture phase, which runs before the board eventSurface bubble listeners. Switched pointerdown to bubble (default third argument); left keydown/focusin on capture. Reverted experimental window-level board routing (elements board index.ts) after Vitest/jsdom issues; elements ContextMenuController bubble dismiss remains on branch.
